scope.title: Working Context ledger as the single live-task read/write source
scope.source: real filesystem JSONL append/read against a temp config dir (no live provider)

decision.reason: Verified on a real temp filesystem that Working Context writes go through the existing workspace Task Ledger JSONL and read back as a consistent projection; a replayed batch is idempotent, a blocked ledger path surfaces a write error, and workspaces are isolated. No second store introduced.

singleSource.noSecondStore: adapter adds no table, snapshot file, daemon, or second store
singleSource.readErrorSemantics: missing ledger -> empty view; corrupt lines -> parser warnings

residual.unknownVsEmpty: A missing ledger returns an empty view; the packet does not add an explicit unknown-vs-empty distinction (corrupt lines are parser warnings).
residual.scope: JSONL single-source path only; no Stage 3 contract change and no new UI/model wiring; no second DB/daemon/migration.

independentVerification.detail: Tests write through the real appender, read back the real projection, replay a batch, block the ledger directory to force a write error, and check workspace isolation. Stage 3 projection/merge semantics remain covered by the existing contract test. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: Working Context reuses the existing workspace Task Ledger JSONL append/read/projection; no new table/snapshot/daemon/second store.
Appended proposal events read back into a consistent projection (pending contains the written proposal).
Replaying the same batchIdempotencyKey appends no duplicate event and yields an identical projection.
When the ledger directory path is occupied by a file, append rejects (does not report success).
A different workspaceId reads an empty view and has no ledger file.
4 new + 10 regression tests pass, typecheck:test 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.

notMeasured: Corrupt-ledger behavior under a torn write (parser warnings only).
A separate second-agent independent verifier role.

landing.note: Pushed with the evidence commit in the same session; see the branch's PR.
